text: Read it: yarareads.finereli.com - free, no account needed. A reading app for kids who have just learned their phonics sounds and need something real to read. Every word in a story can be sounded out with the sounds they already know. When they get stuck, they tap the word and its sound buttons appear right there. I made it for my daughter Yara. She's six and loves glitter, magic and dragons. She'd finished Teach Your Monster to Read and I couldn't find anything for her to read next that was both a good story and made only of words she could sound out. Her big brother Tom wrote the first story, and the app is built so there can be many more. It's a Cloudflare Worker with static assets, D1 for data and R2 for pictures. No build step. If you're a tech dad (or mum) with a kid who's learning to read, I'd love you to take this and make it yours. git clone https://github.com/finereli/yarareads && cd yarareads npm install npx wrangler d1 create yara-reads # put the database_id in wrangler.jsonc, with your account_id npx wrangler r2 bucket create yara-reads-pictures npx wrangler d1 migrations apply yara-reads --local node tools/lexicon-asset.mjs # the word dictionary the worker uses node tools/push.mjs --local --inventory --images --owner dev # load the stories (--owner: books from home, if you have any) npx wrangler dev Then npm run deploy when you're happy (edit the routes in wrangler.jsonc for your domain; deploy needs the dictionary step, which the script runs for you).
